motion_rule: the rolling hook carries her across frame every beat and she never leaves it; sacks and crates sweep past the lens; the camera tracks alongside; new shot size each beat, never wider than her muzzle on a third of frame; ONE sideways move per beat, never up or down
character: a wiry macaque hanging by her tail from a rolling overhead hook, both arms free and level like a beam, muzzle and jaw always clear
second_characters: ONE rat and ONE goat porter, one under each side of the rail a step from the lens, crossing frame themselves, working wide in every spoken beat, never touching her
props: TWO sacks and no others, same cloth, same size, nothing written on them, one in each paw; A SWARM of walnuts; ONE crate in the rat trotters
prop_continuity: both sacks stay identical the whole way; the left only pours out, the right only pulls in
environment: a packed store row, sacks and crates tight both sides, daylight from the roof, no far wall
light_events: flat white noon off the boards, a side shaft on the pouring walnuts at 1.70

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: a level pleased female voice, biting off each word, 4.2 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ba-LANS, so-SHOL-sya, PROS-to, o-BE-ikh, sto-RON, dol-GI
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.20 and 1.20-3.40 each one breath, first word at 0.00; after 3.40 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens on every syllable
audio.sfx: hook on the rail, walnuts hailing on boards, sacking flapping, a long suck of air

timeline.a: the hook drives her into frame, a sack swinging off each paw
she throws both arms out dead level, the two sacks riding side by side past the lens, the same
she kicks off a stack going past
she up-ends the left sack at the lens and walnuts pour out across frame
she swings the right sack into the same spot and up-ends it the same way, same grip
the right sack pulls that whole stream into itself instead, walnuts flying the wrong way past the lens, her muzzle clear
the rat runs in a step from the lens and tips his crate into the left sack, it pours straight back out the far side
she up-ends the right sack over him again and it drags the crate out of his trotters past the lens
she up-ends it a third time over the goat and the spilled walnuts whip off the boards into it, the goat grabbing at nothing
she holds both sacks out dead level at the lens, the left pouring out and the right pulling in, the streams crossing in front of her
she drives her muzzle at the lens between the streams, her face not changing
both streams cut out at once and the sacks go flat together, her arms still dead level
still rolling she turns both sacks inside out at the lens, bare and the same
the rat and goat run past the other way with nothing in their trotters, the hook rolling on

must_appear: TWO sacks the same in every way, side by side before either is up-ended; the left pours walnuts out; the right, up-ended the same way, pulls everything in instead; that test repeats twice more; at 6.60-7.20 her muzzle is at the lens between the streams, her face not changing; she rides the moving hook to the last frame; every word spoken, the last by 3.40
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a static camera, a still background, standing in place, an inscription, digits, cyrillic letters, slow motion, a closed jaw while speaking, a hero moving up or down the frame, weighing scales, a balance with two pans, a third sack, multiple monkeys, a hero taken off the hook
